notes:
- Log out closes Discord at once: Disconnecting no longer queues behind a publish waiting out its fifteen-second READY, and a clear that cannot get the lock returns rather than waiting. A connect that started before the sign-out is abandoned.
- A failed old socket can no longer end the new one: A retired socket's late failure used to close the reconnect that replaced it. Listeners now carry their session epoch and socket, so it is ignored.
- Rich Presence survives a rotation: The app-root host no longer acts on a default disabled setting before DataStore answers, which used to disconnect the live client on every Activity recreation.
- A pasted Discord token loses every prefix: Bearer and Bot are stripped in either order, and a tab after the prefix now counts, so the prefix is not welded onto the token.
- A downloaded update survives a re-check: The once-per-launch check no longer runs over an APK that is already downloaded, so a rotation while offline cannot replace Ready to install with a failure.
